content.comment_body: The [product_name] AM2 AQ features two outputs capable of providing 4-20mA signals. Is it correct that there is no 4-20mA analog input module available?
Hello [user_name], [url] (see page 2) From what I found: -[article_no] - [product_name] AM2 AQ, 2 analog outputs, 0-10V -[article_no] - [product_name] AM2 AQ, 2 analog outputs, 0-10V, 0/4-20mA

[user_name] is correct. Regarding analog inputs: A DC-powered [product_name] offers 2 or 4 analog inputs for 0-10V signals. If you need 0/4-20mA inputs, you'll need the AM2 extension module: [product_name] AM2, 2 analog inputs, 0-10V, 0/4-20mA

The reason I asked is because I read that the [product_name] AM2 AQ offers outputs for both 0-10V and 0/4-20mA, but the one I purchased only had 0-10V outputs. This issue was due to having an older version of the module. The previous version: -[article_no] - [product_name] AM2 AQ, 2 analog outputs, 0-10V And the newer version: -[article_no] - [product_name] AM2 AQ, 2 analog outputs, 0-10V, 0/4-20mA Thank you for the help.

analysis.insight_summary: There was confusion surrounding the options for analog input and output modules, specifically related to 4-20mA support in the [product_name] AM2 AQ series. Contributors identified differences in module versions and a lack of clear specification, which complicated user decisions when selecting the appropriate hardware. Key usability challenges stemmed from unclear product information and differentiation between module capabilities.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward identification of analog modules that support 4-20mA signals for both input and output, alongside easy-to-understand specifications for each product version.
